# netbox_device_type (Data Source)

Reads a single NetBox device type (`/api/dcim/device-types/`) by `id`, `slug` or filters.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Generated by internal/gen; edit generator/overrides to change, or remove this line to hand-maintain.
data "netbox_device_type" "example" {
  slug = "example"
}

# Lookup by arbitrary API filters:
data "netbox_device_type" "filtered" {
  filters = [
    { name = "id", value = "123" },
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `filters` (Attributes List) Additional query filters as name/value pairs, e.g. `{ name = "tenant_id", value = "12" }`. Any query parameter of `/api/dcim/device-types/` is accepted. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--filters))
- `id` (Number) The numeric ID of the object in NetBox.
- `slug` (String) Slug.

### Read-Only

- `airflow` (String) Airflow. Valid values: `front-to-rear`, `rear-to-front`, `left-to-right`, `right-to-left`, `side-to-rear`, `rear-to-side`, `bottom-to-top`, `top-to-bottom`, `passive`, `mixed`. Defaults to the NetBox server default when omitted.
- `comments` (String) Comments. Defaults to the NetBox server default when omitted.
- `console_port_template_count` (Number) Console Port Template Count.
- `console_server_port_template_count` (Number) Console Server Port Template Count.
- `cooling_intake_template_count` (Number) Cooling Intake Template Count.
- `cooling_method` (String) Cooling Method. Valid values: `air`, `liquid`, `hybrid`, `immersion`. Defaults to the NetBox server default when omitted.
- `cooling_outflow_template_count` (Number) Cooling Outflow Template Count.
- `created` (String) Created.
- `custom_fields` (String) Custom field values as a JSON object (`jsonencode({...})`). Only keys present in the configuration are tracked.
- `default_platform_id` (Number) ID of the Platform (`netbox_platform`).
- `description` (String) Description. Defaults to the NetBox server default when omitted.
- `device_bay_template_count` (Number) Device Bay Template Count.
- `device_count` (Number) Device Count.
- `display` (String) Display.
- `display_url` (String) Display Url.
- `end_of_life` (String) The date after which this device type is no longer supported by the manufacturer.
- `exclude_from_utilization` (Boolean) Devices of this type are excluded when calculating rack utilization. Defaults to the NetBox server default when omitted.
- `front_port_template_count` (Number) Front Port Template Count.
- `interface_template_count` (Number) Interface Template Count.
- `inventory_item_template_count` (Number) Inventory Item Template Count.
- `is_full_depth` (Boolean) Device consumes both front and rear rack faces. Defaults to the NetBox server default when omitted.
- `last_updated` (String) Last Updated.
- `manufacturer_id` (Number) ID of the Manufacturer (`netbox_manufacturer`).
- `model` (String) Model.
- `module_bay_template_count` (Number) Module Bay Template Count.
- `owner_id` (Number) ID of the Owner (`netbox_owner`).
- `part_number` (String) Discrete part number (optional). Defaults to the NetBox server default when omitted.
- `power_outlet_template_count` (Number) Power Outlet Template Count.
- `power_port_template_count` (Number) Power Port Template Count.
- `rear_port_template_count` (Number) Rear Port Template Count.
- `subdevice_role` (String) Parent devices house child devices in device bays. Leave blank if this device type is neither a parent nor a child. Valid values: `parent`, `child`. Defaults to the NetBox server default when omitted.
- `tags` (Set of String) Slugs of the tags assigned to this object. Defaults to the NetBox server default when omitted.
- `u_height` (Number) U Height. Defaults to the NetBox server default when omitted.
- `url` (String) Url.
- `weight` (Number) Weight.
- `weight_unit` (String) Weight Unit. Valid values: `kg`, `g`, `lb`, `oz`. Defaults to the NetBox server default when omitted.

Required:

- `name` (String) Query parameter name.
